app_fee.quote: There is a $70 application fee for each application.

gre_general.value: GRE reporting is optional and not considered unless you submit it.
gre_general.quote: Reporting the results of the GRE is optional. We do not consider GRE scores unless you decide to submit them.

toefl_min.value: Qualified applicants have TOEFL iBT 105; a lower score is strongly considered but does not exclude you.
toefl_min.quote: Qualified applicants have a minimum TOEFL score of 620 (paper-based test), 260 (computer-based test), or 105 (Internet test).

ielts_min.value: Qualified applicants have IELTS 7.2 (shown here as 7); a lower score does not exclude you but is strongly considered.
ielts_min.quote: For the IELTS, qualified applicants have a minimum score of 7.2.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee, not by a supervisor; students join a research group after two semesters of courses.
supervisor.quote: Admission to the program is decided by the Graduate Admissions Committee rather than by a potential research supervisor. Only after being admitted and then completing two semesters of courses, do students join a research group.

funding.value: All accepted PhD students get a full tuition waiver, a competitive stipend and health insurance.
funding.quote: All students accepted into our PhD program are granted financial support in the form of a full tuition waiver as well as a competitive stipend and health insurance coverage.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in engineering, applied physics or a related technical field is required.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree in engineering, applied physics, or a related technical field is required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The School of Medicine and Dentistry also lists a Biomedical Engineering PhD; this record uses the Hajim department's own application page.
